Time of delivery (daytime, evening time, nighttime)
Obstetric emergencies (uterine rupture, partial placental abruption, and cord prolapse)
cohort: 9,143 singleton deliveries after 34 weeks of gestation
finding: There were no significant differences in perinatal and maternal outcomes based on the time of delivery, except for a higher incidence of third- and fourth-degree tears during the evening.
